stem.text: In the diagram, curve X was obtained by measuring the volume of oxygen produced during the decomposition of $100\,\text{cm}^3$ of $1.0\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrogen peroxide. A catalyst of manganese(IV) oxide was used.

stem.alt: Graph of volume of oxygen formed against time; two curves rise and level off, labelled X and Y.

stem.text: Which alteration to the original experimental conditions would produce curve Y?
